{{Quote|Nuru Kungurama, I presume?|The impostor to Nuru Kungurama, just prior to his assassination|<ref name="SM3" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] member impersonated [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] '''Langu Sommilor.''' He and two others assaulted [[Langu Sommilor]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on the landing pad on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]]. The impostor, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual, in his guise of Sommilor, a male [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]], [[Mission to Vaced|traveled]] to the planet [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet with his escort to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]]. Once on Vaced, the impostor greeted Kungurama, and was almost immediately [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. Kungurama pursued the sniper and eventually appeared to defeat him. Believing that the impostor really was Sommilor, Kungurama had his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] team [[Breakout Squad]] stow his body onboard his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and intended on returning it to Kynachi. The ship was then used to [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|transport the team to]] [[Bilbringi Depot]].<ref name="SM3" /> After the battle, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Cleaver]] found the real Langu Sommilor and his pilots, who were unconscious and tied up in the freighter's hold. Breakout Squad checked the body and realized it had a [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] mask and [[Color/Legends|gold]] wig. The body of the impostor was turned over to [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] for identification. Although he had a Black Sun [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on his [[Limb/Legends|forearm]], his body had not been identified after four days.<ref name="SM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although first appearing in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]'', he was not revealed to be an impostor until the following book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''.
